newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bau Holding plans autumn capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Bau Holding plans autumn capital increase.

text.p: Austria's biggest construction firm Bau Holding AG said on Monday it planned a capital increase in the autumn tied to its takeover of Munich-based Leonhard Moll AG's construction units.

Bau Holding finance chief Hannes Truntschnig told Reuters the firm had yet to decide the volume of the capital increase but he forecast it would be in the region of five percent of ordinary shares -- or 180 million schillings.
Ordinary shares, with a nominal value of 425 million schillings, account for roughly 3.6 billion schillings of Bau Holding's 4.7 billion schillings total market capitalisation.

Last week Bau Holding announced it was acquiring Moll's heavy construction Hoch- und Tiefbau KG, road building Leonhard Moll Strassenbau KG and other smaller units. In return Moll would get a stake in Bau Holding.

Bau Holding, majority controlled by Austrian Hans Peter Haselsteiner and his family, has declined to reveal how much it paid for the Moll units. It is hoping the acquisition will boost sales by around 2.1 billion schillings.
